svg.text: Anatomy of a .acr file — the mask-raster container
DSC03049.acr · 2,533,768 bytes · 11 records · every offset read from the file
11 x 32 B: md5 | u64 size | u64 offset
first record at 20 + 32 x N = 0x174 · green: 1-ch mask,
blue: 3-ch RGB patch, orange: zlib XMP record
md5 = md5(signature + TIFF), or md5(inflated bytes) for a zlib record
+0x10 TIFF — same layout as the auxiliary\ type-02 records
0x0106 Photometric = 1 (BlackIsZero) — a mask, not a picture
cropped to the mask (XMP Origin places it) · Remove patches: 3-ch 16-bit
2. read N x 32-byte entries @0x14: md5, size, offset
4. 02 00 00 00 01 …: strip 16 bytes, it is a TIFF
5. u32 len + 78 9c: inflate, it is an XMP packet
6. decode tiles: pip install tifffile imagecodecs (JXL)
